inlines.v: REDUND'ANCE, REDUND'ANCY, noun [Latin redundantia, red-undo. See Redound.] 1. Excess or superfluous quantity; superfluity; superabundance; as a redundancy of bile. Labor throws off redundancies. 2. In discourse, superfluity of words.
